gloss: doing as one pleases; having one's own way

definitions.gloss: doing as one pleases; having one's own way
definitions.explanation: Acting freely without restraint or regard for others, often with a negative connotation of selfishness or lack of consideration.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}に{好|す}き{放題|ほうだい}させてはいけない。
examples.english: You shouldn't let children do whatever they want.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{好|す}き{放題|ほうだい}に{金|かね}を{使|つか}っている。
examples.english: He spends money however he pleases.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}いころは{好|す}き{放題|ほうだい}やっていたが、{今|いま}は{反省|はんせい}している。
examples.english: I did whatever I wanted when I was young, but now I regret it.

notes:
A compound of {好|す}き (liking, preference) and {放題|ほうだい} (as much as one likes, without limit). Carries a distinctly negative or critical nuance — used to describe behavior that is selfish, undisciplined, or excessive. Rarely complimentary.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {好|す}き{放題|ほうだい}にする: to do as one pleases
- {好|す}き{放題|ほうだい}に{言|い}う: to say whatever one wants (without restraint)
- {好|す}き{放題|ほうだい}やる: to do whatever one likes

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {言|い}いたい{放題|ほうだい}: saying whatever one wants (critical)
- {食|た}べ{放題|ほうだい}: all-you-can-eat (neutral, commercial) — uses the same {放題|ほうだい} pattern but without the negative nuance
- わがまま: selfish, willful — describes the personality trait rather than the behavior
- {勝手|かって}に: on one's own, without permission — focuses on acting without consent
